name: zmodel_fog_set_distance_start
description: zModel fog distance-start setter stores the new start distance and updates the cached reciprocal distance range only when the new distance range is nonzero.
known_limits: Tier C only; no reviewed VC COFF byte comparison has been accepted, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x476190 validates computing gModel_FogDistanceEnd - distanceStart, storing distanceStart to gModel_FogDistanceStart, comparing the computed range against zero, preserving gModel_FogDistanceInvRange for a zero range, and otherwise storing 1.0f / range to gModel_FogDistanceInvRange before ret 4.

Native smoke zmodel_fog_set_distance_start_smoke verifies positive nonzero range reciprocal update, zero range reciprocal preservation, negative nonzero range reciprocal update, and getter-visible start storage.
